title: Revise the health financing goal and Table 2.4 capabilities
requirements:
- Consider the proposed redraft of 2.4.2 and Table 2.4
- Show coverage determination and claim validation against the Benefits Package Registry
- Add illustrative indicators separating system performance, coverage and effective affordable access, incl. vulnerable groups
- Assess moving the safeguards sub-goal to a higher level; review PFM sub-goals including budget execution
- Extend Goal 6 beyond efficiency to revenue raising and pooling
- Assess whether the exchange carrying the claim lifecycle between payers and providers meets the DPI-H criteria
- Add budget planning, execution and expenditure tracking
- Consider ageing and long-term care among goals
